Thank you for the interest, but MicMyDay does not accept outside pull requests.

The source is published so that an app which listens to a microphone and types
into other apps can be read rather than trusted. It is also sold under a
separate commercial licence, which only works while the copyright sits in one
place, so code from outside cannot be merged.

If you have found a bug, please [open an issue](https://github.com/micmyday/micmyday/issues/new/choose)
and describe it. A clear report of something that is wrong is more use than a
patch that cannot be taken, and fixing it is the work of the day either way.
Ideas and requests are welcome on [Discord](https://discord.gg/59d3eTABXk).

The GPL gives you every right to fork this and build your own, and that is not
discouraged. It is only this repository's history that has to stay in one hand.
